verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const g="lib/journeys/grants.ts",a="app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/learn/actions.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(g)||!fs.existsSync(a))process.exit(79);const gs=fs.readFileSync(g,"utf8"),as=fs.readFileSync(a,"utf8");const i=gs.indexOf("export async function grantExtraCreditIfAny(");if(i<0)process.exit(79);const j=gs.indexOf("\nexport ",i+10);const body=gs.slice(i,j<0?gs.length:j);const guarded=/canEditJourney|author_id|journey\.editSettings/.test(body)||/canEditJourney|journey\.editSettings/.test(as);if(!guarded){console.error("SCAN-722: grantExtraCreditIfAny pays bonus Zaps to anyone who can edit the Journey, so an author can mint unlimited Zaps from their own extra-credit blocks: no author or editor check sits in front of the payout.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: grantExtraCreditIfAny reads the plan author with the item and pays nothing to the author; completeJourneyLessonAction skips both the milestone Gems and the extra-credit Zaps when canEditJourney is true.
